summary: Reads SOP geometry from disk or URL, including geometry previously saved from TouchDesigner, Model Editor, Houdini, or other tools.

key_params.name: normals
key_params.note: Compute normals if the loaded geometry has none.

common_gotchas: `normals` does not overwrite existing normals; it computes them if none exist.
`flipfacing` changes primitive winding/facing and is not the same as generating normals.
Remote loading depends on URL availability and the official docs specifically describe `http://` style URLs.
key_concepts: File In SOP reads SOP geometry from disk or URL, including TouchDesigner and common model/export formats.
`file` can point at local geometry or a web URL; official docs call out `http://` URL usage.
`normals` computes normals only when the loaded geometry has none.
`refresh` and `refreshpulse` support continuous or manual reload workflows.
